because cost-14, cost-15, and cost- $\ge16$  doubles contribute respectively  $5,6,7$  above the baseline nine.Combining with

$$2\ell\le s+p_{14}+p_{15}+r+2q.$$
Using  $G=N+R+\ell$ ,  $N\ge s+p_{14}+p_{15}+q$ , and  $R\ge0$ ,
$$\begin{aligned}
4|M|
&\ge45s+65p_{14}+69p_{15}+73q+9\ell+9r.

$$C=45s+65p_{14}+69p_{15}+73q+9r$$
and
$$D=s+p_{14}+p_{15}+r+2q.$$
Then
$$2C-73D
=17s+57p_{14}+65p_{15}-55r.$$
Since  $r\le p_{15}$ ,
$$2C-73D
\ge17s+57p_{14}+10p_{15}\ge0.$$
Thus
$$C\ge\frac{73}{2}D\ge73\ell,$$
and therefore
$$4|M|\ge73\ell+9\ell=82\ell.$$
Hence
$$\sigma\ge\mu\ge-\frac{2|M|}{41}.$$
Using
$$\sigma=\frac{mn}{2}-|T_{\mathrm{sel}}|-|M|,$$

$$|T_{\mathrm{sel}}|+\frac{39}{41}|M|
\le\frac{mn}{2},$$
equivalently
$$82|T_{\mathrm{sel}}|+78|M|\le41mn.$$
The coefficient comparisons are correct:
$$\frac{39}{41}-\frac{37}{39}
=\frac{4}{1599},$$

$$\frac{39}{41}-\frac56
